candidates.title: Solem BL-IP: release BLE after Home Assistant status polls
candidates.summary_ja: ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy経由のHome Assistant polling後もBLE接続が残り、接続枠や公式Solemアプリ利用を妨げる問題から始まり、実機検証・upstream contribution・stable release・さらに上流のBLE session改善まで進んだBOYAKI最初の完全成功事例。
candidates.summary_en: BOYAKI's first complete success case: a Solem BL-IP BLE-slot problem progressed from a real-world report through prototype, real-hardware validation, upstream contribution and stable releases, then continued into deeper BLE-session improvements upstream.
candidates.pain_ja: Home Assistantのpoll後もBLE slotが占有され、他のBLE client、特に公式Solemアプリが接続しづらくなる。
candidates.pain_en: A Home Assistant poll could keep the BLE slot occupied, making it harder for other BLE clients, especially the official Solem app, to connect.
candidates.target_ja: 通常status poll後はBLEを解放しつつ、既存利用者のpersistent動作はデフォルトのまま維持する。
candidates.target_en: Release BLE after normal status polls while preserving the existing persistent behavior as the default.
candidates.tried_ja: BOYAKIでopt-in release_ble_after_poll prototypeを作成して本人へ返却。本人が実機BL-IP + ESPHome Bluetooth Proxyで検証し、自分のGitHubからupstreamへ提出。その後のmaintainer review、hardening、翻訳follow-up、beta validationを経てstable releaseまで到達。stable後の実機検証でHome Assistant再起動をまたぐstale BLE session edge caseが見つかり、追加のSolem改善がv1.2.31としてstable releaseされ、ESPHome / bleak-esphome側の上流調査へ進んでいる。
candidates.tried_en: BOYAKI prepared an opt-in release_ble_after_poll prototype and returned it to the problem owner. The owner validated it on real BL-IP hardware through an ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy and submitted it upstream from their own GitHub account. Maintainer review, hardening, translation follow-up and beta validation reached stable releases. Post-release hardware validation then exposed a stale BLE-session edge case across a Home Assistant restart; further Solem improvements shipped in stable v1.2.31 while the deeper investigation continues toward ESPHome / bleak-esphome upstream.
candidates.status_label_ja: BOYAKI最初の完全成功事例 — v1.2.31 stable release到達、その先もupstream継続中
candidates.status_label_en: BOYAKI first complete success case — v1.2.31 stable release reached, deeper upstream work continues
candidates.current_candidate_ja: 最初のBLE lifecycle改善に続き、post-release実機検証から見つかったstale session挙動へのSolem側hardeningもv1.2.31としてstable release済み。残る根本課題はESPHome / bleak-esphome側のsession reapingを含むより深い上流調査。
candidates.current_candidate_en: After the original BLE lifecycle improvement, Solem-side hardening for the stale-session behavior found during post-release real-hardware validation also shipped in stable v1.2.31. The remaining root frontier is deeper upstream investigation, including session reaping in ESPHome / bleak-esphome.
candidates.verified_ja: 実機BL-IP + ESPHome Bluetooth Proxyで、通常poll後にproxyが0 active connectionsへ戻ることを確認済み。upstream PR #55はreview/approval後にmergeされ、follow-up PR #58もmerge済み。solem-blip-ha v1.2.30 / solem-blip-ble 0.1.38に続き、solem-blip-ha v1.2.31も2026-08-30にstable release済み。v1.2.31 releaseではstale proxy session下でもstartupを遅延させないschedule first-refresh hardeningと、3回連続BLE polling failure時のstale ESPHome proxy session diagnosticが入り、ESPHome Bluetooth ProxyとnRF52840 USB dongleの実機validationが公開されている。
candidates.verified_en: Verified on real BL-IP hardware through an ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy: after normal status polls the proxy returns to 0 active connections. Upstream PR #55 was reviewed, approved and merged, and follow-up PR #58 was also merged. After solem-blip-ha v1.2.30 / solem-blip-ble 0.1.38, solem-blip-ha v1.2.31 was published as a stable release on 2026-08-30. Its release notes include schedule first-refresh hardening so a stale proxy session cannot delay bootstrap, a diagnostic after three consecutive BLE polling failures, and live validation on ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy and an nRF52840 USB dongle.
candidates.limitations_ja: 初期実機検証ではirrigation/write後に接続が一時的に残り、その後のupdate/pollで解放される挙動が観測された。stable release到達は確認済みだが、すべての実機・全write pathで完全non-persistentと一般化はしない。v1.2.31はstale-session影響をSolem側でhardening・診断可能にしたが、session reapingそのものの根本挙動はESPHome / bleak-esphome側の上流課題として継続中。
candidates.limitations_en: Initial real-hardware validation observed that after irrigation/write operations a connection could remain active briefly and then release after a following update/poll. Stable releases are proven, but the result is not generalized into a claim that every device and every write path is completely non-persistent. v1.2.31 hardens and diagnoses the stale-session impact on the Solem side; session reaping itself remains a deeper ESPHome / bleak-esphome upstream frontier.
candidates.outcome_ja: 一人のユーザーのBLE不便から、BOYAKI prototype、本人による実機検証、本人名義のupstream PR #55、maintainer review/merge、自発的なfollow-up PR #58、翻訳・hardening、solem-blip-ha v1.2.30 / solem-blip-ble 0.1.38 stable releaseまで到達した。さらに本人が自発的に検証を継続してstale BLE session edge caseを発見し、Solem側の追加改善がv1.2.31としてstable releaseされた。v1.2.31ではstale proxy session下のstartup保護と診断が入り、実機validationも公開された。残る根本改善はESPHome / bleak-esphome upstreamへ続いている。問題・人・Evidence・solution・release outcomeが次の改善へ循環したBOYAKI最初の完全成功ループ。
candidates.outcome_en: A small real-world BLE annoyance became a BOYAKI prototype, real-hardware validation by the original user, reporter-owned upstream PR #55, maintainer review and merge, voluntary follow-up PR #58, translations and hardening, and stable releases solem-blip-ha v1.2.30 / solem-blip-ble 0.1.38. Continued voluntary testing then exposed a stale BLE-session edge case, and further Solem-side improvements shipped in stable v1.2.31 with startup protection, diagnostics and published real-hardware validation. The remaining root work continues upstream in ESPHome / bleak-esphome. This is BOYAKI's first complete loop where problem, person, evidence, solution and release outcome kept feeding the next improvement.

participation_roles.problem-owner: I have the same BLE-slot / stale-session / client-blocking problem and can describe my environment.
participation_roles.tester: I can test stable releases, Home Assistant restart behavior, irrigation/write behavior, or related BLE lifecycle behavior on real hardware.
participation_roles.maker: I can investigate or improve remaining BLE lifecycle and stale-session behavior.
participation_roles.contributor: I can review upstream changes, translations, docs, releases, diagnostics, or related evidence.

upstream.deeper_upstream_frontier: ESPHome / bleak-esphome stale BLE session behavior

candidates.public_consent: The original problem owner explicitly permitted BOYAKI to retain this as a solution candidate and use the runtime feedback, and later explicitly said they would be happy for the Solem case to become one of the first complete Maker Space examples when BOYAKI is ready.
candidates.identity_policy: The public case may describe the participant's role and contributions, but BOYAKI does not publish personal contact details. A public display name is only shown through the participation surface when the participant chooses one.
